A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''subaltern''' helped [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Red Qurang]]'' in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he helped [[Sabotage of Zonama Sekot|extract]] [[Nom Anor]] from the living [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].
